mentions.name: Floxtop
mentions.description: A native Mac app that organizes and renames files using AI. It inspects each file's contents to suggest the right folder, and everything runs locally on the Mac with no cloud or servers involved. It works in 50 languages (English, German, French, Spanish, Swedish, and more) and handles images (via OCR and object recognition), PDFs, Microsoft Office files, ePubs, text, Markdown, and many other file types, helping tidy messy folders anywhere on the Mac.
mentions.problem: Messy folders anywhere on the Mac that need organizing and renaming.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Building https://floxtop.com, a native Mac app that organizes and rename your files with reliable AI.

It looks inside each file to see what it’s about, then suggest the right folder for you.

Everything happens on your Mac, so nothing leaves your computer. No clouds, no servers.
